skills.name: Do Stay a While
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to 4 strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: Excuse Me
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
Performs a quick dodge to the side.

skills.name: Forgive My Rudeness
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: Returned Courtesy
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: More Overtime?
skills.desc:
After activating a Defensive Assist, press [Assist] again to activate:
Roxy stays on the field and strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
This skill is treated as activating a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: At Your Service
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Allow Me to Assist
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Midnight Code
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strikes enemies ahead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Much Obliged
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a forward strike, dealing Wind DMG.

skills.name: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off
skills.desc:
After activating EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace, this attack is automatically activated when the total number of Eyes of the StormEye of the StormEX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes all Wind Energy, leaving the corresponding number of Eyes of the Storm on the field. When hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off, they detonate to generate Miniature Windstorms or Giant Windstorms. on the field and Roxy's Wind Energy reaches at least 3:
Throws her hammer at enemies on the field, dealing Wind DMG.
Eyes of the Storm hit by this attack are detonated, up to 3 Eyes of the Storm at a time. Based on the number detonated, a corresponding number of Miniature Windstorms are generated, dealing Wind DMG.
If 3 Eyes of the Storm are detonated at once, a Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Don't Catch a Chill
skills.desc:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Kindly Rest in Peace
skills.desc:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill ends:
Consumes all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the attack, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 Eye of the StormEye of the StormEX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes all Wind Energy, leaving the corresponding number of Eyes of the Storm on the field. When hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off, they detonate to generate Miniature Windstorms or Giant Windstorms. at the current position.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Eye of the Storm
skills.desc:
Generated after EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes Wind Energy, and automatically detonates after 30s.
Up to 9 Eyes of the Storm can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated Eye of the Storm will automatically detonate.
Detonates when hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Miniature Windstorm is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
When detonated by any means, an Eye of the Storm releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Gale-Burial Great Hammer
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front, dealing massive Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Requiem for the Night-Burial
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After the skill ends, gains 1 Wind Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Warm Night's Embrace
skills.desc:
Gain 1 point of Wind Energy for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 Wind Energy.
When Roxy's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of 560, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of 46.
After Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off hits an enemy affected by Windswept, it triggers Cleanse, reverting Contamination back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 25%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 11.5%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.

skills.name: Porcelloy Heart
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Rupture, or Armorer character:
Roxy's DMG increases by %. This effect increases with character level, increasing by % per level, up to %.
When any squad member's attack hits an enemy, it increases their Stun DMG Multiplier by %. When an enemy becomes Stunned, its Stun duration is extended by s. This Stun duration increase does not stack with similar effects. The effect is removed once the Stun ends.
While an enemy is in the Windswept state applied by a squad member, the direct Wind DMG they take and the direct DMG they take of the attribute that triggered Contamination are increased by %.
Upon entering the battlefield, restores Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every s.
Windswept applied by all squad members lasts s longer.
When using an EX Special Attack, Roxy's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by % for s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cons.name: Versatile Attendant
cons.desc: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by % for s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by %.

cons.name: Clocking Out Myth
cons.desc:
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals % more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow, up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by % until the target recovers from Stun.

cons.name: Tales of Insomnia
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: R.I.P.
cons.desc:
When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains Energy, up to once per skill.
When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants Energy, up to once per skill.
Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals % more DMG and % more Daze.

cons.name: Second Heartbeat
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Eternity and the Clockwork Doll
cons.desc:
The DMG dealt by attacks ignores % of the target's Wind RES.
When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho.
The DMG dealt by the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by %.
